title: Depth-one recursive NAND costs
statement: Let $F_d$ and $T_d$ be real sequences defined by $F_0=T_0=1$, $F_{d+1}=2T_d$, and $T_{d+1}=F_d+T_d/2$ for every natural number $d$. Then $F_1=2$ and $T_1=3/2$.
